opening_message: Hey — can you read back my cart for me, item by item? Include the gift wrap and the promo discount so I can double-check the math.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You have a cart with three items — a SlimBook, SoundMax Headphones (one is a gift and should be wrapped), and two PixelShot webcams. You applied SAVE50 for $50 off. You want the agent to read back EVERY line with price and quantity, AND confirm the gift wrap fee AND the SAVE50 discount, AND give you the subtotal and final total. You are NOT making changes — just verifying.
known_info: You have three items: SlimBook, SoundMax Headphones, and PixelShot Webcam(s).
You are NOT making changes — read-only.
task_rules: You only want a read-only item-by-item cart readback that includes quantities, prices, gift wrap, the applied promo discount, subtotal, and final total; do not ask for or agree to any cart, promo, shipping, loyalty, checkout, or account changes.
Do not volunteer exact item prices, fees, discount amounts, subtotal, or total before the agent surfaces them; ask the agent to look up the cart if they need details.
If the agent asks what you expect to be in the cart, provide only the broad items you know: a SlimBook, SoundMax Headphones with gift wrap, two PixelShot webcams, and SAVE50 applied.

Accept the readback only if it includes SlimBook Air 13 quantity 1, SoundMax Headphones quantity 1, PixelShot Webcam quantity 2, the gift-wrapped headphones, the $5 gift-wrap fee, SAVE50 with a $50 discount, subtotal $1,156, and total $1,111.
If the readback misses an item, quantity, gift-wrap status, the $5 wrap fee, SAVE50, the $50 discount, subtotal, or total, ask once for the agent to double-check the missing or incorrect part.
If the agent quotes a subtotal or total that conflicts with the expected $1,156 subtotal or $1,111 total, say the math does not look right and ask them to recheck those totals.

If the agent proposes or performs any cart, promo, shipping, loyalty, checkout, or account mutation, push back that this was only a readback request and ask them to leave or restore the cart unchanged.

End with [TASK_DONE] only after the agent has provided the complete accurate readback, or after one correction attempt if the agent still cannot provide a complete readback or clearly cannot keep the interaction read-only.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A Standard-tier returning customer (shop_004, Taylor Kim) has a complex seeded cart: SlimBook Air 13 ($849 × 1), SoundMax Headphones ($149 × 1, gift-wrapped), PixelShot Webcam ($79 × 2 = $158). Gift-wrap fee $5, SAVE50 applied for $50 off. Subtotal $1,156, total $1,111. Customer asks for an item-by-item readback including gift wrap and discount. Agent must accurately enumerate every line AND surface the fee / discount / subtotal / total. Read-only turn; no mutations. Final state: cart unchanged.

**Challenge:** Readback completeness and accuracy on a dense cart. Failure modes: skipping an item (3-line readback becomes 2), omitting the gift-wrap fee, omitting the promo discount, misquoting subtotal or total, or silently mutating (re-applying the promo, auto-adding shipping, etc.). Tests whether the agent can faithfully serialize a complex cart state back to the customer without losing information.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent listed all three cart lines with correct quantities: the SlimBook laptop (qty 1), the SoundMax headphones line (qty 1), and the PixelShot webcam line (qty 2). Judge on item identity and quantity, not exact name strings; accept the catalog names returned by get_cart (e.g. 'SoundMax Wireless Headphones', 'PixelShot Webcam 1080p'). Missing any of the three lines, or a wrong quantity, fails.
Agent mentioned the gift-wrapped headphones and the $5 gift-wrap fee. Missing the wrap status or the $5 fee fails.
Agent mentioned SAVE50 and the $50 discount. Missing either fails.
Agent quoted subtotal $1,156 AND total $1,111. Either missing or wrong fails.
Agent did NOT call add_to_cart, update_cart_item, remove_from_cart, apply_promo, or cancel_promo. This is a pure readback; any mutation violates the customer's explicit 'just verifying' intent.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
